name: List item
layerWhy: It is one row of a list; the list does the job.
promise: One thing per row: what it is, a line about it, and its state at the end.
expectation: Rows divided by thin lines, each with something at the start and the end.
evidence: The lines mean only "separate items of one list"; the title wraps, never cut.
behaviour: The title links to the thing; the end holds a status or an action.
relationships: The current item (aria-current) takes the primary's quiet fill.
failures: Never repeats a fact (a dot and the same word).
dont: A list item as a page section.
